description:
## What

`spec/dns_cache_spec.cr` has one uncommitted line:

    require "./support/crest_http_client_test_helpers"

The file `spec/support/crest_http_client_test_helpers.cr` exists and defines
`debug_*` helpers via class reopening. Without the require, the spec file would
not compile (the helpers are referenced).

## Why

The user said: "fold it into the new work." This means: do not commit it
standalone on main; land it as part of the refactor series.

## How

Include the spec change in the first refactor commit (DNSCache extraction or
the DRY fix). Verify the spec still references valid helpers afterwards.

## Done when

- `git log` shows the require line committed alongside the first refactor.
- `dns_cache_spec.cr` runs without load errors.
title: Fold uncommitted dns_cache_spec.cr require into refactor
